sentence: The theory predicts what the corpus shows: a generic technology yields nothing defensible by itself, because rivals can buy and deploy the same thing [CITE], and returns depend on the situating work of grounding, bounding and recasting
passage: [Kemp (2024), pp. 618--619] "Grounding involves orchestrating which experiences one's AI will be allowed to learn from across the organization. Bounding involves efforts to shape the experiences anchoring a competitor's AI. Recasting involves orchestrating the continual adaptation of algorithms and their surrounding routines to enhance AI's alignment with interdependent activities in a firm."
